overview: The paper introduces Recurrent-Depth Simulator (RecurrSim), an architecture-agnostic framework that enables explicit test-time control over accuracy-cost trade-offs in neural PDE simulators by adjusting the number of recurrent iterations K, validated across fluid dynamics benchmarks (Burgers, KdV, KS, 3D CNS, Active Matter, ShapeNet-Car) and multiple architectural backbones (FNO, ViT, UPT).

modules.name: PDE Data Generation Module
modules.description: Generates simulation data for 1D PDEs (Burgers, KdV, KS) using pseudo-spectral methods with configurable time-stepping solvers (RK23, RK45, LSODA), initial conditions sampled from truncated Fourier series with random coefficients, and periodic boundary conditions; handles dataset splitting into training/testing sets with configurable temporal horizons and warm-up phase construction for short-horizon variants.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing & Loading Module
modules.description: Implements spatial downsampling, max-value normalization across trajectories, residual prediction target construction (predicting next-state increments), input-output pair creation with configurable prediction step size, and custom PyTorch Dataset/DataLoader with sub-batch loading from disk for high-dimensional datasets (3D CNS with 62GB).

modules.name: Fourier Layer Module
modules.description: Implements the core Fourier Neural Operator layer consisting of FFT-based spectral transformation with learned linear mapping on truncated Fourier modes, inverse FFT, skip connection with point-wise convolution, bias term, and activation; supports variants with residual connections and feedforward blocks.

modules.name: RecurrSim Framework Module
modules.description: Implements the main Recurrent-Depth Simulator framework consisting of three components: an encoder (transforms input state to conditioning vector c), a recurrent-depth block (iteratively updates latent z_k conditioned on c for K steps), and a decoder (maps final latent z_K to predicted state); provides the plug-and-play interface for architecture-agnostic instantiation.

modules.name: RecurrFNO Architecture Module
modules.description: Instantiates RecurrSim with Fourier Neural Operator primitives in two variants: (1) RecurrFNO w/o EncDec using point-wise lift/projection with single Fourier layer recurrent block, and (2) RecurrFNO w/ EncDec adding additional Fourier layers in encoder and decoder; supports configurable parameter budgets by scaling channel width.

modules.name: RecurrViT Architecture Module
modules.description: Instantiates RecurrSim with Vision Transformer primitives for Active Matter simulations, adapting the ViT backbone by replacing its intermediate layers with the recurrent-depth block mechanism while maintaining patch embedding and positional encoding for Eulerian simulation data.

modules.name: RecurrUPT Architecture Module
modules.description: Instantiates RecurrSim with Universal Physics Transformer primitives for ShapeNet-Car experiments, adapting the UPT approximator module by reducing depth and wrapping it in the recurrent-depth block to achieve parameter reduction while maintaining compatibility with the original UPT framework.

modules.name: K Sampling & Initial Latent Distribution Module
modules.description: Implements Poisson log-normal distribution sampling for the number of recurrent iterations K during training (with configurable mean K̄ and variance σ), and supports multiple initial latent vector distributions (standard normal, zero initialization, conditioning initialization, learnable initialization) for z0.

modules.name: Merging Strategies Module
modules.description: Implements six methods for merging conditioning vector c with latent vector z_k at each recurrent iteration: plain addition, learnable scalar weighting, element-wise learnable weighting, point-wise projection (with and without identity initialization), and raw concatenation fed into the recurrent block's first layer.

modules.name: Training Loop with Truncated BPTT Module
modules.description: Implements the end-to-end training procedure with truncated backpropagation-through-depth: applies the recurrent block K-B times without gradient tracking followed by B times with gradient tracking to bound memory at O(B) regardless of K; samples K per training example from the Poisson log-normal distribution; computes supervised L2 loss on single-step predictions.

modules.name: Optimizer & Scheduler Module
modules.description: Configures the AdamW optimizer with specified weight decay, and a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler that decays from initial to final learning rate; supports gradient accumulation for effective batch size simulation on memory-constrained high-dimensional experiments.

modules.name: Baseline Implementations Module
modules.description: Implements three adaptive-compute baseline methods: (1) FNO-DEQ with Anderson acceleration and phantom gradient backward pass, (2) ACDM autoregressive conditional diffusion model with linear scheduler and UNet backbone, and (3) PDE-Refiner with configurable noise scheduler and multi-step refinement with both fixed and adaptive inference step variants.

modules.name: Trajectory Error Metric Module
modules.description: Computes the L2 trajectory error by measuring the average squared difference between predicted and true states across all spatial points and time steps after N-fold autoregressive application of the neural simulator; supports evaluation at different rollout horizons and recurrent iteration settings.

modules.name: Correlation Horizon Metric Module
modules.description: Computes the average and worst-case correlation horizons for chaotic systems (KS equation): finds the earliest time at which Pearson correlation coefficient between true and predicted states falls below threshold α; sweeps over multiple α thresholds and inference depths K to produce correlation horizon surfaces.

modules.name: Accuracy-Cost Curve Evaluation Module
modules.description: Generates accuracy-cost curves by sweeping the number of recurrent iterations K at test time, computing trajectory error (or correlation horizons for chaotic systems) at each K value, and plotting the trade-off; supports comparison across multiple methods (RecurrFNO, FNO-DEQ, ACDM, PDE-Refiner) and visualization of trajectories at selected K values.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework Module
modules.description: Systematically evaluates the impact of key hyperparameters and design choices: backpropagation window B (sweep over values, measure trajectory error saturation), distribution parameter K̄ (sweep, measure best achievable error and low-K performance degradation), initial latent distribution comparison, and merging strategy comparison across parameter budgets.

modules.name: Fixed Point Convergence Analysis Module
modules.description: Analyzes the convergence behavior of latent vectors z_k toward a fixed point z* by measuring Euclidean distance ||z_k - z*|| across recurrent iterations and timesteps; visualizes convergence heatmaps over spatiotemporal trajectories to reveal physics-aligned behavior (e.g., more iterations needed during shock formation in Burgers equation).

modules.name: Experiment Configuration & Logging Module
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations including dataset settings, architecture hyperparameters, training schedules, and evaluation protocols; provides logging of training metrics, experiment tracking with seed management for reproducibility, model checkpoint saving/loading, and automated generation of result tables (parameter counts, memory usage, MSE comparisons) and accuracy-cost curve plots.
